_comment: Field heroes in combat (issue #10). Looks come from data/recruits.json; this file is how they fight. short: name on the HUD. hp, speed (px/s), damage (full-power swing), power_rate (gauge refill per second), reach (px), arc (degrees either side of facing). ai: how they behave when you are not controlling them (one of the presets in styles, logic in scripts/ally_ai.gd; the player can change it per hero in the quick menu Party tab). ink: Ink pool for abilities (refills 0.4 per second, +1 for every full-power hit that lands; data/abilities.json). abilities: up to 4, on keys 1-4 / LB RB LT RT / touch buttons. heal: a passive poultice that patches the most hurt ally in range every few seconds, controlled or not. trail: the weapon trail drawn in code over every swing (art pass): colour, and style arc (a sweep) or thrust (a straight jab).

aggressive.name: Aggressive
aggressive.desc: Charges in, swings early, spends Ink and techs on anything in reach.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.desc: Full-gauge strikes, backs off to refill, saves techs for crowds and elites.

distance.name: Keep Distance
distance.desc: Circles at range, darts in on a full gauge, dashes clear, techs from afar.

support.name: Support
support.desc: Sticks to the leader, heals early, techs what crowds the leader.

ash.special: Unwritten: the Blank hesitates. Ash always leads the party.

bran.special: Big, slow, hard to kill. Clause four: guard the client.

gristle.special: Poultice: every 6 s she patches the most hurt ally nearby for 7 HP. Billing follows.

ninefingers.special: Longest reach in the party, on a narrow line. Aim the point.

ottoline.special: Most HP in the party and barely budges when hit. Short reach: get in close and stun them.

jessamy.special: Fastest hero, fastest gauge, throws knives. Fragile: vanish when it gets hot, then strike from the dark.

odile.special: Biggest Ink pool. Audit makes enemies take +50% from everyone; Levy drains them to heal the party.

velvette.special: Narrow, quick thrusts. Time Riposte just before a blow lands to turn it back. Her tech finishes off the wounded.

hortense.special: Flirts with everything, enemies included. Beguiled enemies forget to fight, and she hits them half again as hard. Masked Step puts her behind whoever she is looking at.

saffron.special: The longest swing in the party, and the songs: Torch Song makes everyone nearby hit harder and charge faster; Showstopper sings a gilded chorus girl into being for the enemies to fight.

nan.special: Two fighters for one fee. Small Print makes everything nearby hit softer and walk slower; Tally's Turn sends her shadow off to punch on his own.
